convert_hifigan_checkpoint: convert a HiFi-GAN checkpoint from FastSpeech2Conformer to a Hugging Face PyTorch model
remap_hifigan_yaml_config: remap an ESPNet HiFi-GAN YAML config to Hugging Face FastSpeech2Conformer config format
load_weights: load and apply weights from an original checkpoint into a Hugging Face HiFi-GAN model
run_convert_cli: run the convert_hifigan_checkpoint CLI with checkpoint_path, yaml_config_path, and output folder
push_to_hub: push a converted HiFi-GAN model to a Hugging Face Hub repository by specifying repo_id
